audit_scope: Read-only prerequisite gate for the source-exact combined component native trial. Does not launch Vivado or contact hardware.

profile.label: combined
profile.initial_profile_uniqueness_guard: Current native.py binds profile_label to preparation and dispatch and rejects a duplicate initial profile unless separately hypothesis-qualified.

canonical_qualification.control_comparison: Both candidate seeds match the frozen V109 FETCH actual RTL control stdout/events/cycles and canonical artifacts. Control is reused, not recounted.

source_closure.origin_hashes: Pinned in the prepared inputs and source_contract; every origin and prepared snapshot was independently recomputed during this audit.

prepared_recipe.parser_selftest: PASS_ACTUAL_V109_FETCH_REPORTS; prepared launcher checked exact parse equality against pinned V109 FETCH receipt. Root separately reports match across all four actual V109 report sets.
prepared_recipe.clock: One component_clk at 10.000 ns, waveform {0.000 5.000}; component.xdc loaded before synthesis in fresh RTL mode.
prepared_recipe.constraints: No false/multicycle path, waiver, invented board I/O delay, or timing exception is present in the prepared XDC/Tcl. Only the fixed component clock is constrained.

parent_checkpoint.run_mode: Fresh RTL synthesis. The checkpoint is hash-pinned and mounted read-only as provenance; it is not substituted for fresh RTL synthesis.

implementation_budget.launch_resource_gate: MemAvailable at least 8 GiB and PSI full avg10 below 1; stop thresholds are recorded in policy/runner.

report_scope.local_predicate_mapping: Read-only TSV reports cell instance, primitive, location and INIT for busy_owned/fault_pending/fault_ack matching cells where available; no preservation properties are applied.
report_scope.methodology_report: Rich per-run report records native findings, fixed clock/constraints, applicable actions and open gates; report does not change timing constraints.
report_scope.qualification_limits: The route is out-of-context and does not qualify moonshine_top, board I/O/CDC, hardware 30 fps, or strict complete validated decode below 10 ms.
